nominal_scale.kind: nominal art-direction choice, not a newly measured fossil dimension; display scaling separately labeled

budget_intent.policy: 14k triangles and 1,000,000 bytes are ceilings, not targets. Usually aim about 100–500 KB; below this range is fine. Spend more triangles only for visible silhouette/proportion/connection benefit. Do not pad counts or enlarge textures for apparent refinement. Preserve quality if a justified asset exceeds the usual range within the hard caps.

start_gate: Next round is planning only; parent explicit exclusive assignment needed. For already assigned workers, latest state and explicit parent dispatch override stale empty claims or initial queue snapshots.
concurrency: Parent-coordinated shared host pool; default one worker x two Blender threads, no per-batch full-host allocation.

design.observed: Shallow warm limestone tray-like former floor with ivory angular broken sheets and air-visible thin edges. Quiet exposed patches, varied plate sizes, mostly low-angle overlaps. Exact sheet shapes/layout disagree in top versus hero.
design.resolve: Freeze one original asymmetric layout of 18 sheets; retain characteristic larger left and center fragments, broken small fragments near front, and visible quiet substrate on right. All sheet undersides and edges have authored thickness; low-angle overlaps are intentional. No water or pearl spheres.
design.masses: Low irregular basin floor with low discontinuous rim and closed underside. Thin solid irregular polygon plates have beveled upper margins, occasional small edge teeth and locally tilted faces. Macro break planes dominate; no uniform facet noise.
